hydration.name: Purify the water
hydration.description: A glass of water with each meal. Still the best supply in the bunker.

exercise.name: Outrun something
exercise.description: Twenty minutes of movement. Pursuit optional.

sleep.name: Bunker bedtime
sleep.description: Head to bed at a set time. Sleep is the one supply that recharges itself.

reading.name: Scavenge a few pages
reading.description: Read for fifteen minutes. The last library will not read itself.

mindfulness.name: Five minutes of quiet
mindfulness.description: Sit still, breathe slowly, ignore the distant noises.

screentime.name: Conserve the battery
screentime.description: Put the phone down half an hour before bed. Nothing new out there anyway.

diet.name: Eat something green
diet.description: One portion of vegetables. Fresh beats tinned, and the peaches agree.

other.name: Daily radio check
other.description: Check in once a day to confirm you are still here.
